title: AI Prompt Guard Service Config
description: Enterprise only. Adds [Prompt Guard](https://www.krakend.io/docs/enterprise/ai-gateway/prompt-guard/) protection to the endpoint.

name.title: Name of the custom prompt guard
name.description: A free form name to be used from the endpoint config to select this prompt guard.

kind.title: The kind of prompt guarding to apply
kind.description: The fields of the `config` field depend on the kind of prompt guard selected.

severity.title: Severity level
severity.description: Select what how critical this guard is.

config.title: Specific options for the kind of prompt guard

patterns.description: List of regular expression to check

oneOf.title: Classifier config
oneOf.description: Configuration fields for an external classifier

score_threshold.title: Score threshold
score_threshold.description: If the external classifier score is below the provided value, the prompt guard blocks the request.

on_failure_block.title: On Failure Block
on_failure_block.description: If the external classifier service is unavailable or returns an error, decide if the request should be blocked.

oneOf.title: Policy config
oneOf.description: Configuration fields for a policy classifier

expressions.title: Expressions
expressions.description: A list of CEL expressions to be evauluated.
